card.title: How To Fix an iPad Pro 10.5 That Is Boot Looping or Stuck on the Apple Logo

source.title: How To Fix an iPad Pro 10.5 That Is Boot Looping or Stuck on the Apple Logo

claims.statement: An iPad Pro 10.5 stuck looping at the Apple logo, failing restores with error 4013, is usually hardware: a faulty headphone jack extension flex or loose/cracked coils on the logic board.
Disconnecting the headphone jack extension flex and booting normally confirms the flex as the cause.
Loose coils can look intact; probe them gently with tweezers under a microscope for movement, lifted pads or cracked joints.

procedure: Disconnect the headphone jack extension flex and try to boot.
If it boots, replace the flex.
Otherwise probe coils around the board under a microscope.
Replace loose coils with same value/size donor coils.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
